title: Should you build a capsule wardrobe
titleChinese: 你可能也需要一个“胶囊衣橱”
paragraphs: Do you ever struggle with choosing your outfit in the morning? If you have a full wardrobe yet still feel you don't have anything to wear, you might want to build yourself a capsule wardrobe!

So, what is this? Put simply, a capsule wardrobe is a small selection of items of clothing that complement each other, and are therefore interchangeable. Key to the capsule wardrobe is solid basics, like plain tops, and, ideally, neutral colours, because they make combinations easier. Think about the versatility of a simple pair of denim jeans. They can be combined with trainers and a t-shirt for a casual look or a blazer paired with heels, or loafers, if you want to look more sophisticated. Fashion bloggers also talk about timeless classics – picture a luxury black handbag that will suit any occasion and won't go out of style.

But why might it be beneficial to build a capsule wardrobe? Well, by limiting your choices, it can become much easier to choose what to wear, but there is another advantage too – it can reduce the amount of fast fashion. Fast fashion refers to clothes which are trendy for just a short time, so are quickly replaced by newer trends. This results in cheap and poor-quality clothing which has huge environmental costs as waste goes to landfill, resulting in an increase in pollution. According to UK clothes waste charity TRAID, the average garment is worn just 10 times before being disposed of. So, having a capsule wardrobe with long-lasting and high-quality clothes should help reduce this, even if it means paying more in the first place.

Fashion and lifestyle magazine, Vogue, says 'building an excellent capsule wardrobe takes time and patience'. But, if you want to reduce waste and have some extra time in the morning, it might be time to start building!

vocabulary.entry: struggle with /ˈstrʌɡl wɪð/ 处理……有困难；努力应对（某事）
vocabulary.example: Many people struggle with the pressure of modern life.
vocabulary.translation: 很多人难以应对现代生活的压力。

vocabulary.entry: outfit /ˈaʊtfɪt/ n. 全套穿搭；成套服装
vocabulary.example: She chose a casual outfit for the weekend trip.
vocabulary.translation: 她为周末的旅行选了一身休闲穿搭。

vocabulary.entry: wardrobe /ˈwɔːdrəʊb/ n. （一个人的）全部衣物；衣橱
vocabulary.example: Her summer wardrobe consists mainly of light dresses and shorts.
vocabulary.translation: 她的夏季衣物主要是轻薄的连衣裙和短裤。

vocabulary.entry: capsule wardrobe /ˈkæpsjuːl ˈwɔːdrəʊb/ n. 胶囊衣橱（精简百搭的基础款衣物组合）
vocabulary.example: A capsule wardrobe is a great choice for minimalists who hate cluttered closets.
vocabulary.translation: 胶囊衣橱是讨厌衣橱杂乱的极简主义者的绝佳选择。

vocabulary.entry: interchangeable /ˌɪntəˈtʃeɪndʒəbl/ adj. 可互换的；可交替搭配的
vocabulary.example: The buttons on this shirt are interchangeable with those on the jacket.
vocabulary.translation: 这件衬衫的纽扣可以和那件夹克的交替使用。

vocabulary.entry: solid basics /ˈsɒlɪd ˈbeɪsɪks/ n. 经典基础款服饰；百搭基础单品
vocabulary.example: Solid basics are the foundation of a practical and stylish wardrobe.
vocabulary.translation: 经典基础款是实用又时髦衣橱的核心。

vocabulary.entry: neutral colour /ˈnjuːtrəl ˈkʌlə(r)/ n. 中性色
vocabulary.example: Neutral colour is easy to match with any bright hue in an outfit.
vocabulary.translation: 中性色能轻松和穿搭中的任何亮色搭配。

vocabulary.entry: combination /ˌkɒmbɪˈneɪʃn/ n. （衣物的）搭配；组合
vocabulary.example: This combination of a sweater and a skirt works well for spring.
vocabulary.translation: 毛衣配裙子的这套搭配很适合春天。

vocabulary.entry: versatility /ˌvɜːsəˈtɪləti/ n. （衣物的）百搭性；多功能性
vocabulary.example: The versatility of this coat makes it suitable for both formal and casual wear.
vocabulary.translation: 这件外套的百搭性让它正装、休闲穿搭都合适。

vocabulary.entry: denim /ˈdenɪm/ n. 牛仔布；牛仔服饰 adj. 牛仔布的
vocabulary.example: Denim is a durable fabric that never goes out of fashion.
vocabulary.translation: 牛仔布是一种耐用且永不过时的面料。

vocabulary.entry: trainer /ˈtreɪnə(r)/ n. 运动鞋（英式英语）
vocabulary.example: I wear white trainers with almost all my casual clothes.
vocabulary.translation: 我几乎所有休闲装都搭配白色运动鞋。

vocabulary.entry: blazer /ˈbleɪzə(r)/ n. 休闲西装；便装外套
vocabulary.example: A navy blazer is a timeless piece for both men and women.
vocabulary.translation: 藏青色休闲西装是男女皆宜的经典单品。

vocabulary.entry: loafer /ˈləʊfə(r)/ n. 乐福鞋（无鞋带套脚皮鞋）
vocabulary.example: Loafer are a staple in smart-casual footwear for office workers.
vocabulary.translation: 乐福鞋是上班族半正式穿搭中的必备鞋款。

vocabulary.entry: sophisticated /səˈfɪstɪkeɪtɪd/ adj. （穿搭）精致的；高雅的
vocabulary.example: She looked sophisticated in a tailored blazer and silk blouse.
vocabulary.translation: 她穿着剪裁合身的休闲西装和真丝衬衫，看上去十分高雅。

vocabulary.entry: timeless classic /ˈtaɪmləs ˈklæsɪk/ n. 永不过时的经典单品；永恒经典
vocabulary.example: A trench coat is a timeless classic that suits most body types.
vocabulary.translation: 风衣是适合大多数身材的永不过时经典单品。

vocabulary.entry: luxury /ˈlʌkʃəri/ adj. 奢华的；高端的 n. 奢侈品
vocabulary.example: She invested in a luxury leather belt that would last for years.
vocabulary.translation: 她买了一条高端皮质腰带，能用很多年。

vocabulary.entry: go out of style /ɡəʊ aʊt ɒv staɪl/ 过时；不再流行
vocabulary.example: Classic designs never go out of style no matter what the trend is.
vocabulary.translation: 无论潮流如何，经典设计永远不会过时。

vocabulary.entry: beneficial /ˌbenɪˈfɪʃl/ adj. 有益的；有好处的
vocabulary.example: Eating fresh fruit is beneficial to your digestive system.
vocabulary.translation: 吃新鲜水果对你的消化系统有益。

vocabulary.entry: fast fashion /ˈfɑːst ˈfæʃn/ n. 快时尚（快速推出低价潮流服饰的模式）
vocabulary.example: Fast fashion has caused a lot of environmental problems in recent years.
vocabulary.translation: 近年来，快时尚引发了诸多环境问题。

vocabulary.entry: environmental cost /ɪnˌvaɪrənˈmentl kɒst/ n. 环境成本；环境代价
vocabulary.example: The environmental cost of mass production is often ignored by manufacturers.
vocabulary.translation: 大规模生产的环境代价常常被生产商忽视。

vocabulary.entry: landfill /ˈlændfɪl/ n. 垃圾填埋场；填埋处理
vocabulary.example: Millions of tons of textile waste end up in landfill every year.
vocabulary.translation: 每年有数百万吨纺织废料最终被送到垃圾填埋场。

vocabulary.entry: pollution /pəˈluːʃn/ n. 污染；污染物
vocabulary.example: Textile dyeing is one of the main causes of water pollution in some areas.
vocabulary.translation: 纺织品印染是部分地区水污染的主要原因之一。

vocabulary.entry: garment /ˈɡɑːmənt/ n. 衣服；服装（正式书面语，尤指单件）
vocabulary.example: Each garment is checked carefully for defects before being shipped.
vocabulary.translation: 每件服装在发货前都会被仔细检查是否有瑕疵。

vocabulary.entry: dispose of /dɪˈspəʊz ɒv/ 丢弃；处理（废弃物）
vocabulary.example: It's important to dispose of old clothes in an environmentally friendly way.
vocabulary.translation: 以环保的方式处理旧衣物十分重要。

vocabulary.entry: long-lasting /ˌlɒŋ ˈlɑːstɪŋ/ adj. （衣物）耐用的；持久的
vocabulary.example: This long-lasting fabric is resistant to fading and tearing.
vocabulary.translation: 这种耐用的面料耐褪色、耐撕裂。

vocabulary.entry: high-quality /ˌhaɪ ˈkwɒləti/ adj. 高品质的；优质的
vocabulary.example: High-quality clothing is usually more expensive but worth the investment.
vocabulary.translation: 高品质的服装通常价格更高，但值得购买。

vocabulary.entry: in the first place /ɪn ðə fɜːst pleɪs/ 起初；一开始
vocabulary.example: Why did you buy the dress in the first place if you don't like it?
vocabulary.translation: 如果你不喜欢这条裙子，一开始为什么要买？

vocabulary.entry: tailored /ˈteɪləd/ adj. 剪裁合身的；定制的
vocabulary.example: A tailored blazer can instantly make an outfit look more polished.
vocabulary.translation: 一件剪裁合身的休闲西装能让穿搭立刻显得更精致。

sentences.english: Do you ever struggle with choosing your outfit in the morning?
sentences.chinese: 你早上是否总为挑选穿搭而发愁？

sentences.english: If you have a full wardrobe yet still feel you don't have anything to wear, you might want to build yourself a capsule wardrobe!
sentences.chinese: 要是你的衣柜明明满满当当，却依然觉得没衣服可穿，那或许你该给自己打造一个胶囊衣橱了！
那么，什么是胶囊衣橱呢？

sentences.english: Put simply, a capsule wardrobe is a small selection of items of clothing that complement each other, and are therefore interchangeable.
sentences.chinese: 简单来说，胶囊衣橱就是一小部分相互搭配、可以灵活组合的衣物。

sentences.english: Key to the capsule wardrobe is solid basics, like plain tops, and, ideally, neutral colours, because they make combinations easier.
sentences.chinese: 胶囊衣橱的核心是基础款单品，比如纯色上衣，而且最好是中性色系，因为这类颜色更容易搭配。

sentences.english: Think about the versatility of a simple pair of denim jeans. They can be combined with trainers and a t-shirt for a casual look or a blazer paired with heels, or loafers, if you want to look more sophisticated.
sentences.chinese: 想想一条简约牛仔裤的百搭性：搭配运动鞋和T恤，就是一身休闲装扮；要是想穿得更精致些，配上西装外套和高跟鞋或乐福鞋就好。

sentences.english: Fashion bloggers also talk about timeless classics – picture a luxury black handbag that will suit any occasion and won't go out of style.
sentences.chinese: 时尚博主们还会提到永不过时的经典款——比如一只质感高级的黑色手提包，它适配各种场合，而且永远不会过时。

sentences.english: But why might it be beneficial to build a capsule wardrobe?
sentences.chinese: 不过，打造胶囊衣橱到底有什么好处呢？

sentences.english: Well, by limiting your choices, it can become much easier to choose what to wear, but there is another advantage too – it can reduce the amount of fast fashion.
sentences.chinese: 首先，精简衣物选择后，早上挑衣服会变得轻松很多；其次，它还能减少快时尚的消费。

sentences.english: Fast fashion refers to clothes which are trendy for just a short time, so are quickly replaced by newer trends.
sentences.chinese: 快时尚指的是那些只流行很短时间、很快就会被新潮流取代的服装。

sentences.english: This results in cheap and poor-quality clothing which has huge environmental costs as waste goes to landfill, resulting in an increase in pollution.
sentences.chinese: 这类价格低廉、质量较差的衣物被当做垃圾送往填埋场，会造成严重的环境污染。

sentences.english: According to UK clothes waste charity TRAID, the average garment is worn just 10 times before being disposed of.
sentences.chinese: 英国衣物回收慈善机构TRAID的数据显示，一件衣服平均只被穿10次就会被丢弃。

sentences.english: So, having a capsule wardrobe with long-lasting and high-quality clothes should help reduce this, even if it means paying more in the first place.
sentences.chinese: 因此，拥有一个由耐穿、高品质衣物组成的胶囊衣橱，即便初期投入更高，也有助于减少这种浪费现象。

sentences.english: Fashion and lifestyle magazine, Vogue, says 'building an excellent capsule wardrobe takes time and patience'.
sentences.chinese: 时尚生活杂志《VOGUE》称“打造一个优质的胶囊衣橱需要时间和耐心”。

sentences.english: But, if you want to reduce waste and have some extra time in the morning, it might be time to start building!
sentences.chinese: 但如果你既想减少衣物浪费，又想在早上多睡几分钟，那现在或许就是开启胶囊衣橱计划的好时机！
